evaluation_criteria.actual_mundari_support: Verified presence of 'unr' ISO code or native Mundari audio
evaluation_criteria.real_audio: Whether authentic human speech recordings are included
evaluation_criteria.speakers: Number and demographic diversity of real speakers
evaluation_criteria.transcripts: Availability and script of ground-truth text
evaluation_criteria.redistribution: Permission to redistribute model/data in educational software
evaluation_criteria.offline_android: Feasibility of running on <= 3 GB RAM Android device without network
evaluation_criteria.recommendation: Operational role within our modular architecture

candidates.real_audio: Trained on real Mundari Scripture speech (~30-40 hrs)
candidates.speakers: Small cohort of adult native readers
candidates.offline_android: NO (Requires 4-6 GB RAM; causes OOM on low-cost devices)
candidates.recommendation: RESEARCH_SERVER_BENCHMARK (Reference ASR baseline; not deployable on edge Android)
candidates.strengths: Direct Mundari ASR capability out of the box; legitimate language-specific adapter.
candidates.limitations: Prohibitive parameter scale for low-cost mobile hardware; Biblical domain bias.

candidates.real_audio: Trained on authentic Mundari voice recordings
candidates.offline_android: YES (Exportable via ONNX / TFLite; fits in < 150 MB RAM)
candidates.strengths: Ultra-lightweight end-to-end VITS; native Mundari phonology; mobile-feasible.
candidates.limitations: Synthetic audio must NOT be used to claim ASR accuracy or as fake training data.

candidates.real_audio: N/A for Mundari (Supported for Hindi, 1000s hrs)
candidates.offline_android: YES (Feasible via whisper.tflite / whisper.cpp in < 200 MB RAM)
candidates.recommendation: HINDI_ASR_BRIDGE (Capability B: Teacher Hindi Voice -> Hindi Text)
candidates.strengths: Highly robust offline Hindi transcription; extremely efficient edge runtime.

candidates.actual_mundari_support: NO (0 Mundari audio; covers only 22 scheduled languages)
candidates.recommendation: NOT_USABLE_FOR_MUNDARI (Marked NOT SUFFICIENT FOR MUNDARI SPEECH)
candidates.limitations: Mundari is completely absent; using it introduces linguistic distortion.

candidates.strengths: Authentic studio recordings; verified text transcripts.
candidates.limitations: 0 isolated 1-20 takes; only 2 adult speakers; insufficient for edge training.

candidates.offline_android: YES (198 KB FP16 TFLite; < 5 MB RAM; < 15ms latency on low-cost CPU)
candidates.recommendation: BASELINE_CONTROLLED_VOCABULARY (Pipeline validation & FLN MVP edge engine)
candidates.strengths: Extremely lightweight; real-time streaming; deterministic fallback integration.
candidates.limitations: Current status is BASELINE / VALIDATION until real isolated audio is ingested.
